summary: Axogen, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a follow-on common stock offering of 4,910,000 shares at $42.50 per share, roughly a 10.1% discount to the $47.27 September 9 close, for gross proceeds of about $208.7 million and $196.2 million net of underwriting discounts. Underwriters, led by BofA Securities with Jefferies, Wells Fargo, Mizuho and Lake Street, hold a 30-day option for 736,500 additional shares. Closing is expected on or about September 11, 2026. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch pricing pressure and dilution.
